title: Layout / portrait and landscape formats
slide_intent: Adapt the arrangement to format while keeping stable roles so the brand remains recognizable.
strategic_value: DB’s mark, headline and bar sequence can connect a narrow poster with a wide image-and-text layout.
demonstration: A portrait worker poster is paired with a landscape train image adjoining a white IMMER BESSER panel.
practical_value: Compare a compact vertical composition with a split landscape composition.

content_islands.name: Portrait application
content_islands.spec: Place the worker photograph beside a dark text panel within the tall poster.

content_islands.name: Landscape application
content_islands.spec: Pair a train close-up with the white headline panel and red Schwelle.

reference_purposes.Application: The two examples show the layout system across portrait and landscape formats.
